title: Grateful Dead Live at Town Park on 1987-08-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkII) -> Apogee MiniMe (24bit/48k) -> Samplitude Professional v9.02 -> FLAC/16
taper: Thanks to Paul Scotton and Joani Walker for the tapes

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording praised as a great tape but hampered by mis‑ordered post‑break tracks
ai_review.review: The reviewer calls the tape great, indicating solid sound quality typical of a soundboard source, yet points out that the tracks after the set break are mislabeled, which detracts from the listening experience. No musical performance details were given.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate‑star review; positive remarks about tape quality balanced by a complaint about track ordering, leading to an overall middling rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall great tape quality noted, but post‑set break tracks are misaligned/mislabeled, causing confusion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No comments on performance; only issue mentioned is track ordering after the set break.
